name: gl-water-drop
title: WaterDrop transition
description: Ripples spread from the center like a drop falling into water, crossfading to the incoming image. Load vendor/glintmotion/hyper-shader.js, then this file, then call HyperShader.init({ transitions: [{ time, shader: "gl-water-drop", duration }] }).
author: Paweł Płóciennik
